title: add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Maya Patel
description: Adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples to redwood-examples and updates the docs site to surface the new guides. Motivation: make it easier for developers to onboard with RAG+agent patterns using Redwood's tool-calling and structured output features. This PR includes three quickstarts (python, typescript, and a lightweight docker example), a collection of RAG templates for common retrieval strategies (semantic-only, hybrid BM25+semantic, prefix-caching), agent presets for tool-calling (search, calendar, and KB lookup), and docs site pages with runnable snippets and API references. Checklist: - [x] Add example code and tests - [x] Docs pages with step-by-step quickstarts - [x] Update sidebar and navigation - [x] Add CI smoke tests for examples - [x] Add basic linting and type hints for TS/py examples Related: ENG-2148 for quickstart metrics, PM-627 for docs placement.
commits: Initial commit: add rag-templates and agent-presets

notes_on_changes: Examples include small helper library (redwood_examples.rag.helpers) with single-file implementations. TS quickstart uses the SDK v0.9 client, py quickstart pins to 0.9.x. Docker quickstart demonstrates private deployment wiring for local testing.
release_notes: New: RAG agent quickstarts (Python, TypeScript, Docker) and tool-calling examples; Docs: RAG quickstart guide and agent preset reference added to docs site.
maintainer_notes: Follow-up: Add telemetry for quickstart onboarding (ENG-2210). Consider adding additional datasets and an eval harness for RAG quality in a follow-up PR.
significant_design_decisions: Provide three retrieval templates to cover common production patterns; agent presets are intentionally minimal and meant as starting points rather than production configs.
